annotation.title_clean: AC101-1 - Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) under 25 kilograms - Operating in compliance with Part 101 Rules [Trial]
annotation.title_en: AC101-1 - Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) under 25 kilograms - Operating in compliance with Part 101 Rules [Trial]
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Authority of New Zealand (CAA)
annotation.summary_en: Trial Revision 2 of a New Zealand CAA Advisory Circular describing an acceptable means of compliance for operating remotely piloted aircraft under 25 kg under Civil Aviation Rule Part 101. Operators are invited to use it and give feedback, collected March 2026, before an updated version later in 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets out an acceptable means of compliance for RPAS under 25 kg under Part 101
Revision 2 substantively updates content and removes obsolete material
Directs users to CATI:101-1 for Subpart E rules
Trial period from 22 December 2025, with feedback collected in March 2026
AC should be preferred over web guidance where they conflict
